source.mutability: Gong publishes structured endpoint pages but no stable downloadable OpenAPI URL. Generation normalizes and hash-locks all 60 current endpoint definitions; the pack intentionally omits openapi_source.

exclusions.reason: Gong requires multipart/form-data carrying a binary LDJSON dataFile up to 200 MB. Admitting a JSON body would lie about the wire contract, so CRM bulk upload remains fail-closed.
Gong requires multipart/form-data with a binary mediaFile up to 1.5 GB. The composition REST adapter emits JSON or literal bodies and cannot truthfully construct this multipart upload.

auth.enrollment: basic access key and access key secret

authority_notes.request_schema_dialect: Closed request schemas are emitted only when every admitted argument is scalar; the current validator dialect cannot represent object or array properties.
authority_notes.pagination_safety: Automatic walks replay only the admitted route and stop at the engine page and record ceilings.
